letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie—every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. As the calendar flips, I’m reminded how our love, sealed on that bright February day, only grows richer with each passing season. You are my compass, my laughter, my home wherever we are. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into magical memories. I love you more than words can hold, today and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or rain‑kissed lanes,  
Your smile outshines the sun’s warm rays.  
Together we dance, hearts intertwined,  
Love’s sweet song, forever rhymed.
